title: Synonym precision item 7
instructions: Choose the word that best preserves the exact meaning, degree and attitude supported by the sentence.

parts.prompt: The coach's feedback was ___: it named the mistake directly while remaining respectful and focused on improvement.

choice_rationales.A: Harsh adds excessive severity, which conflicts with the respectful and improvement-focused delivery.
choice_rationales.B: Blunt often suggests directness without enough sensitivity; the sentence explicitly preserves respect.
choice_rationales.C: Frank expresses honest directness without requiring the negative attitude carried by the other options.
choice_rationales.D: Rude means disrespectful, the opposite of the stated manner.

parts.hint: Predict ‘honestly direct without being disrespectful’, then compare the attitude carried by each option.
parts.correct_explanation: ‘Frank’ preserves the direct honesty supported by the sentence without adding unnecessary severity or disrespect.
